name: MAC Mobility | 64K MACs Bulk Learn/Move | Scale Stress
source: gap-analysis:G3 from SW-204115 meeting notes: '64k macs moved at the same time. can be delay of around 5 seconds'
status_note: G3 wired 2026-04-21 via Block 3 spirent_bulk_learn_assert handler. The handler uses the new --count parameter added to spirent_inject_evpn_mac_route (2026-04-21) to inject N RT-2 routes from a base MAC in a single Spirent API call, avoiding N round-trips. SC01 = bulk learn, SC02 = bulk move (re-inject with different next-hop + higher seq), SC03 = rapid flap (call handler 3 times with alternating next-hops). Cross-layer check is disabled via bulk_learn recipe profile -- iterating 64K MAC entries would balloon the verdict engine.
gap_rationale: SW-204115 meeting notes explicitly discuss 64K MAC simultaneous move with an expected ~5 second delay. No existing test covers this scale scenario. This is critical for validating system behavior under bulk mobility stress, including FIB programming latency, BGP RT-2 storm handling, and suppression threshold behavior.

device_requirements.notes: Cluster device preferred for realistic scale. Spirent strongly recommended for 64K MAC generation.

prerequisites.check_command: show bgp l2vpn evpn summary | no-more

prerequisites.description: l2vpn-vpls BGP session ESTABLISHED (required for SI VPLS label exchange)
prerequisites.command: show bgp l2vpn vpls summary | no-more

prerequisites.check_command: show config network-services evpn instance {evpn_name} | no-more
show config network-services evpn instance {evpn_name} mac-handling | no-more

config_before_test.description: Base EVPN-VPLS SI with two ACs. Spirent connected to both ACs. Spirent generates 64K unique source MACs on AC1, then moves all 64K to AC2 simultaneously.
config_before_test.suppression_note: Ensure suppression thresholds are set high enough (>64K) to avoid false positives, OR test with default thresholds to observe expected suppression behavior under scale.

scenarios.name: Learn 64K MACs on AC1 via Spirent; verify all learned
scenarios.what_happens: Spirent sends 64K unique source MACs on AC1. DUT must learn all 64K, program NCP forwarding table, and advertise 64K RT-2 routes to BGP peers.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: MAC table overflow. NPU resource exhaustion. BGP session reset.

trigger.note: Handler: spirent_bulk_learn_assert -> single RT-2 inject with --count 65536.

scenarios.name: Move all 64K MACs from AC1 to AC2 simultaneously; measure delay
scenarios.what_happens: Spirent stops sending on AC1, starts sending same 64K MACs on AC2. DUT must: (1) detect 64K MAC moves, (2) update all MAC table entries, (3) update all RT-2 routes, (4) reprogram NCP forwarding. Expected completion: ~5 seconds per meeting notes.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: System crash. bgpd restart. Permanent blackhole. Forwarding stuck in old state after 30 seconds.

trigger.note: Handler: spirent_bulk_learn_assert -> re-inject 64K routes with higher seq + different next-hop to simulate move from PE-A to PE-B.

show_commands: show evpn forwarding-table mac-address-table instance {evpn_name} | count
poll_convergence.convergence_criteria: all MACs show AC2 as source

scenarios.name: Rapid bulk flap at 64K scale; suppression behavior
scenarios.what_happens: After SC02, rapidly flap 64K MACs back and forth (AC2->AC1->AC2) 3 times in quick succession. Suppression should trigger. Verify system stability under extreme suppression load.
scenarios.what_cannot_happen: System hang. Memory exhaustion. Process crash.

trigger.note: Handler: spirent_bulk_learn_assert -> single flap cycle (back to PE-A, seq=2). SC03 runs after SC02 so this is flap #3 overall.

show_commands: show evpn mac-table instance {evpn_name} suppress | no-more
show bgp l2vpn evpn summary | no-more
